narrative.intro: Fluor Intercontinental obligated $279M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date across 13 awards, with an average award size of $21.5M and obligations up 89.2% year over year. Fiscal-year history shows obligations of $286M in FY21, $313M in FY22, $34.6M in FY23, $142M in FY24, and $148M in FY25. Facilities Support Services is the dominant market, accounting for $279M in FY2026 to date. The company also shows obligations of $500 in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) and $0 in All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services. Current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the note clarifies that award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values. This profile highlights where Fluor Intercontinental’s federal revenue is concentrated and how FY2026 to date compares to prior fiscal years.
